assertions.description: exportKeyingMaterial is a function on WebTransport.prototype.
All three parameters (label, context, outputLength) are required: the function's length is 3.
A label over 255 bytes rejects with RangeError even on a failed session — argument validation precedes the state check in the spec's method steps.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.ready; } catch { /* expected */ } try { await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(256), new Uint8Array(1), 32); return false; } catch (e) { try { t.close(); } catch { /* failed */ } return e instanceof RangeError; } })()

assertions.description: A context over 255 bytes rejects with RangeError.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.ready; } catch { /* expected */ } try { await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(1), new Uint8Array(256), 32); return false; } catch (e) { try { t.close(); } catch { /* failed */ } return e instanceof RangeError; } })()

assertions.description: An outputLength of 0 rejects with RangeError (the valid range starts at 1; the implementation ceiling must be at least 4096).
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.ready; } catch { /* expected */ } try { await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(1), new Uint8Array(1), 0); return false; } catch (e) { try { t.close(); } catch { /* failed */ } return e instanceof RangeError; } })()

assertions.description: With valid arguments, a session whose state is failed rejects with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.ready; } catch { /* expected */ } try { await t.exportKeyingMaterial(new Uint8Array(8), new Uint8Array(8), 32); return false; } catch (e) { try { t.close(); } catch { /* failed */ } return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()

assertions.description: The method is [NewObject]: two invocations return two distinct Promise objects.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.exportKeyingMaterial !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const u = new Uint8Array(4); const p1 = t.exportKeyingMaterial(u, u, 32); const p2 = t.exportKeyingMaterial(u, u, 32); p1.catch(() => {}); p2.catch(() => {}); t.close(); return p1 instanceof Promise && p2 instanceof Promise && p1 !== p2; })()
